items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: That's right. And who did you say the trombone was? I forgot. Raymond. Raymond Brown. Raymond Brown.

ctx.x: Did we get the trumpets in the band, or...? Well, the trumpet, George McCormick. Just one trumpet, and one trumpet, one trombone.
That's right. And who did you say the trombone was? I forgot. Raymond. Raymond Brown. Raymond Brown.
Yeah. That's ancient spartanone. That's right, huh?
